dispatch: Session 182 pulled the vault back from silence: a Worker self-loop after Pages migration had starved the apex of every byte, and a targeted hostname rewrite sealed it — six of six smoke gates, verified. The forge ran deeper: a 23-item audit (combined priority 407.7) sparked seven shipped fixes, trimming 1.18 MB of dead weight and hardening the edge before the next deployment. One frontier remains open — build:check drifts with live data, logged, not hidden.
